secrets.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Random 32+ char secret for NextAuth JWT session signing. Generated for development.

secrets.name: ANALYTICS_SALT
secrets.description: Secure salt for HMAC-SHA256 visitor key hashing. Generated for development.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk publishable key (pk_test_... or pk_live_...) from https://dashboard.clerk.com → API Keys. Required for the app to render — ClerkProvider and clerkMiddleware both need it.

secrets.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk secret key (sk_test_... or sk_live_...) from https://dashboard.clerk.com → API Keys. Required for the app to render — clerkMiddleware will throw without it.
